name: manual_2e60b5
claim: A scoped pip-check health gate must require installed project metadata and distinguish a completed check reporting recognized unrelated conflicts from a failed or incomplete invocation. Missing pip, absent metadata, exceptions, unexpected output or indeterminate exit status must fail closed. Test with disposable venvs created by the fixture, not a pre-prepared ambient TEMP directory.
